## What this measures — and what it does not

For commander `C` and role `R`:

```text
expected[C, R] = SUM over cards ( count[C, card] / denominator[C] ) x isRole(card, R)
```

This is a mean-style expected count, not a percentile. Two commanders can have the same expected role count while having different lower-tail deck shapes, so this corpus does not support a floor. These figures feed no floor and no go/no-go.

## Denominator integrity

- Denominator mismatches: 146
- `edhrec.csv` aggregates by a single commander name while `averages.csv` carries 3,372 solo rows and 3,213 partner-pair rows, so it is not established whether partner-pair decks are included in a commander's counts; a ratio above 1.0 proves the denominator is wrong for that commander and those commanders are excluded rather than clamped.
- Worst five mismatches (already ordered by ratio descending):
  - Haldan, Avid Arcanist | Island | count=7942 | denominator=1 | ratio=7942
  - Atreus, Impulsive Son | Mountain | count=11328 | denominator=5 | ratio=2265.6
  - Jenny Flint | Forest | count=2140 | denominator=3 | ratio=713.333
  - Dargo, the Shipwrecker | Sol Ring | count=7830 | denominator=11 | ratio=711.818
  - Kraum, Ludevic's Opus | Command Tower | count=14618 | denominator=22 | ratio=664.455

## Known gaps

- No bracket dimension exists in this archive.
- Unresolved cards are excluded from classification and counted explicitly: 0.
- `other` is excluded because it is a residual classifier-coverage bucket rather than a deck-construction target.
- Classification is oracle-only via the shipped Cut Lab assigner call shape used by the other corpus arms.
- A mean-style expected count cannot support a floor.
